2610.08659.title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
2610.08659.paper_summary: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.
2610.08659.paper_summary_zh: 模型合併提供了一種無需訓練的方式，將推理能力從語言模型轉移到視覺-語言模型 (VLMs)，但基於端點的轉移可能會將先前存在的模型差異與訓練後推理過程中獲得的變化混淆。我們則圍繞訓練階段的更新來制定能力轉移，隔離強化學習 (RL) 所引起的參數變化。然而，完整轉移此更新仍然是次優的：我們發現其組成部分在跨模型轉移性上有顯著差異，主要方向的轉移效果優於完整更新。基於這一發現，我們引入了選擇性強化學習 (Selective-RL)，該方法隔離了 RL 階段的更新，保留其主導的矩陣方向並保持幅度，並將其轉移到 VLM 的語言模塊。在三個模型系列和五個視覺推理基準上，選擇性強化學習在 15 次比較中有 12 次改善了完整更新的插值，包括在 Qwen 接收者上獲得 8.55 個百分點的 MathVision 增益。匹配的對照組顯示，僅更新幅度或任意低秩並未重現這些增益。這些結果突顯了訓練後獲得的內容與跨模型可轉移的內容之間的區別，提供了對跨模型能力轉移的訓練階段視角。代碼可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl 獲得。
